scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run migrate-remote && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.migrate-local: pnpm run generate-migration && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply newsletter --local
scripts.migrate-remote: pnpm run generate-migration && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply newsletter --remote
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && pnpm run migrate-local && pnpm exec wrangler dev
